text:
Two things sit at the top of the list for Mira:

- **Egg allergy.** She's had mild hives from egg. The sitter should know to check labels and avoid egg in any form, and have your number plus the pediatric office's on hand. If you've got an action plan from your doctor, leave a copy on the fridge — if you don't, that's worth a quick call to ask for one.
- **Blue elephant at naps.** She settles with it, so make sure it's findable before nap time, not after the crying starts.

Want me to draft a one-page sitter note you can print?
